svg.text: Retail Banking Card Dispute (Reg E), Installment APR (TILA Reg Z) & FDCPA Voice Architecture
Reg E/Z Dispute & Instant Apple/Google Wallet Token Push · TILA Verbatim APR Lock · FDCPA Reg F 7-in-7 & Bankruptcy 0ms Stop
RETAIL-BANKING-REG-E-FDCPA-01
1. Cardholder Line & Core Banking Bus
FIS / Fiserv / Temenos · Visa Verifi / Mastercard Ethoca
App Authenticated & PSTN Cardholder Ingress
• Pre-authenticated mobile app VoIP token + voiceprint
• PCI-DSS Level 1 DTMF/voice PAN & CVV masking
Auth_State = Mobile_Biometric_Token_Verified
Visa Verifi / Ethoca Merchant Enrichment
• Resolves cryptic descriptor "SQ *BLUEBOTTLE 881" to
exact store logo, GPS map & digital item receipt
False_Unrecognized_Dispute_Deflection = 41.5%
TILA Reg Z Installment & APR Calculator
• Converts monthly installment fee to effective APR%
• Calculates exact total interest + principal schedule
Effective_APR = 14.85% (Mandatory Verbatim Readout)
FDCPA Reg F Collections & Bankruptcy Registry
• Rolling 7-day call counter (<7 attempts per debt)
• PACER Bankruptcy Chapter 7/13 & Cease-Desist flag
Call_Count_7d = 2 / 7 | Bankruptcy_Stay = None
2. Deterministic Reg E, Reg Z & Reg F Gate
Zero Hidden APR · 7-in-7 Collections Lock · 0ms Bankruptcy Stop
Gate A: TILA Reg Z Verbatim APR & FDCPA 7-in-7 Lock
• Blocks installment enrollment unless effective APR%
and total finance charge are read & confirmed
• Enforces Mini-Miranda & blocks 8th call in 7 days
Hidden_APR_Or_RegF_Overcall_Violation = 0.0%
CFPB_UDAAP_Disclosure_Audit_Pass = 100.0%
Gate B: Reg E Dispute & Digital Wallet Token Gate
• Shows Verifi/Ethoca receipt first (deflects 41.5%)
• On true fraud: locks PAN in <100ms, pushes new
Apple/Google Pay token & logs 10-day provisional credit
Card_Replacement_Spend_Continuity = 100% (0d Gap)
Reg_E_Provisional_Credit_SLA = 100% On-Time
Gate C: 0ms Bankruptcy Stay & Elder Abuse Bridge
• Detects caller stating "I filed bankruptcy / I have
an attorney / Stop calling" or elder scam coercion
• Terminates collection script in 0ms, locks account
under 11 USC 362 Automatic Stay & bridges Fraud/Legal
if (bankruptcyAttorneyOrElderScamAlert) -> 0ms Halt
P99_Gate_Latency = 16ms | Automatic_Stay_Breach = 0%
3. Wallet Provisioning & Banking ROI
Visa VTS Push · Hardship Plan · Chargeback Save
Instant Digital Wallet Re-Issuance (VTS / MDES)
• Replaces compromised card in Apple/Google Pay before
the call ends (no 5-day wait for plastic mail)
• Auto-updates Netflix/Uber/Amazon card-on-file tokens
Dispute_Call_Handle_Time = 85s (vs 11.5m Manual)
Empathetic Self-Cure & Hardship Restructuring
• Judgment-free voice option for 30-day delinquent accounts
• Offers pre-approved payment-date shift or 3-part plan
• Lifts promise-to-pay (PTP) fulfillment vs human collectors
Early_Delinquency_Self_Cure_Lift = +28%
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k Card/Loan Calls)
• Manual Card & Collections Desk: $115,000 / 10k calls
• Hybrid RegE/RegZ/RegF Voice: $1,190 / 10k calls (Rec)
• Unguarded Banking Bot: $1,950 + CFPB enforcement risk
Avoided_False_Chargeback_Fees = $103,750 / 10k Calls
CFPB_Violations = 0 | Wallet_Active_In_Call = 100%
